From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, December 14, 2018 3:14 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: FW: Won-Lost Records

From: Kenneth Clover <keclover@aol.com> 
Sent: Friday, December 14, 2018 3:13 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Won-Lost Records
Ken Clover here again with another complaint...

Ever since Anthony Ferench became the Free Press baseball writer, he repeatedly refuses to include a pitcher's won-lost record in his stories.  For present pitchers and new even new acquisitions (i.e. Matt Moore and Tyson Ross), no won-lost record.  To me, it's a part of a pitcher's pedigree.  After all, pitchers are usually judged on won-lost record and they are included in the daily probables.  So they must have some merit.

Perhaps Anthony feels that won-lost is not a true indicator of a pitcher's talents.  I disagree.  He freely mentions ERA, WHIP, innings pitched, strikeouts per inning...all those stats, but not won-lost.
I particularly wanted to know the won-lost marks for the new pitchers Ross and Moore, to give me a better feel of how they have fared in the past and their worth.
Please ask him to use won-lost for a pitcher in the future.  Even if he has to hold his nose.  If he won't, can you at least include a separate box with that information?
